en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Salama bin Khattab, from Ibrahim bin Muhammed al-Thaqafi, from Ibrahim bin Maimoun, from Mus’ab, from Sa’d, from Asbagh, from Ali, peace be upon him,
with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And they said: Our Lord, hasten for us our share before the Day of Reckoning.» [38:16] Their share of the torment.
